layout.hierarchy: The circular diagram dominates visually (largest area, central position). The red bold title is second in weight. The nine mint-green word boxes and the eight red '+ω' labels are the next layer of detail. The formula box, slide-number oval, red frame, and black bar are small peripheral accents.

visual_elements.description: Title block: three lines of bold red sans-serif text, left-aligned, third line indented right: 'Sequence of 9 words' / 'Positions are defined' / 'as angles'.

Central pale-yellow filled circle (center at ~60% slide width, ~52% slide height; diameter ~26% of slide width) representing an angle/phase space. A thin red DASHED horizontal axis passes through the circle center spanning roughly x 26%-93% of the slide; a red DASHED vertical axis passes through the center from ~y 8% to ~y 94%. Red dashed radial spokes run from the center to just beyond the rim at ~30-degree intervals. Nine small mint-green rectangles (~65x22 px) with thin borders sit OUTSIDE the rim on the spokes, counterclockwise from the 3-o'clock position: 'Word 0' at 0 degrees (right, horizontal), 'Word 1' at ~30 degrees, 'Word 2' at ~60 degrees, 'Word 3' at 90 degrees (top, box vertical with text rotated reading bottom-to-top), 'Word 4' at ~120 degrees, 'Word 5' at ~150 degrees, 'Word 6' at 180 degrees (left, horizontal), 'Word 7' at ~210 degrees, 'Word 8' at ~240 degrees (lower-left); each box is rotated parallel to its spoke. Eight thin curved orange-red arrows arc counterclockwise outside the word boxes, connecting each word to the next (Word 0 to Word 1, Word 1 to Word 2, ... Word 7 to Word 8), each terminating in a small solid triangular arrowhead at the destination word; a red bold-italic '+ω' label sits beside the midpoint of each of the 8 arcs. One extra dashed spoke continues to ~330 degrees (lower-right) with no word box attached.
visual_elements.position: center-right of slide, occupying roughly x 28-96%, y 8-95%

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title: bold, ~24-26 px, red, three lines, left-aligned with the third line ('as angles') indented right. Word-box labels: bold italic, ~13 px, green. '+ω' labels: bold italic, ~16 px, red. Formula-box text: bold, ~15 px, blue for Sin/Cos lines and green for the t= line. Slide number: bold, ~16 px, black. No serif fonts, no all-caps, no numbered bullets anywhere. For PowerPoint rebuilding, treat the px estimates as pt equivalents (title ~24 pt, word-box labels ~13 pt, '+ω' labels ~16 pt, formula lines ~15 pt, slide number ~16 pt).

recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to pure white (#FFFFFF).
2. Draw the content frame: a thin red (#CC0000) rectangle outline, no fill, inset ~6% from the left and right edges and ~8% from the top, with its bottom edge at ~95% of slide height where it meets the black bottom bar (do not extend below the bar).
3. Add the title at top-left (spanning approx x 6-33%, y 9-24%): three left-aligned lines in Arial bold ~24 pt red (#CC0000): line 1 'Sequence of 9 words'; line 2 'Positions are defined'; line 3 'as angles', indented ~0.5 in to the right (indent approximate; source notes only 'indented right').
4. Draw the central circle: pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) filled circle, center at 60% of slide width and 52% of slide height, diameter ~26% of slide width, with a very thin gray-green outline [?].
5. Draw the dashed axes in red (#CC0000): a horizontal dashed line through the circle center spanning x 26-93% of slide width, and a vertical dashed line through the center spanning y 8-94% of slide height.
6. Draw 10 red (#CC0000) dashed radial spokes from the circle center to just beyond the rim, at 0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240 and 330 degrees measured counterclockwise from the 3-o'clock direction; the 330-degree spoke (lower-right) carries no word box.
7. Create 9 word boxes: mint-green (#CCFFCC) filled rectangles ~0.9 x 0.3 in (approx 65 x 22 px) with thin borders, each rotated parallel to its spoke and placed just outside the circle rim, counterclockwise from 3 o'clock: 'Word 0' at 0 degrees (right, horizontal); 'Word 1' at 30 degrees; 'Word 2' at 60 degrees; 'Word 3' at 90 degrees (top, box vertical, text rotated to read bottom-to-top); 'Word 4' at 120 degrees; 'Word 5' at 150 degrees; 'Word 6' at 180 degrees (left, horizontal); 'Word 7' at 210 degrees; 'Word 8' at 240 degrees (lower-left). Text in every box: bold italic ~13 pt green (#009900).
8. Draw 8 thin curved arrows outside the word boxes, each arcing counterclockwise from Word k to Word k+1 (Word 0 to Word 1, Word 1 to Word 2, ... Word 7 to Word 8), stroke orange-red (#E06040), each ending in a small solid triangular arrowhead in orange (#FF6600) at the destination word.
9. Place 8 red (#CC0000) bold italic '+ω' labels (~16 pt), one beside the midpoint of each of the 8 arcs.
10. Draw the formula box at middle-left below the title (approx x 8-23%, y 34-47%): pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) filled rectangle with a thin gold (#E0C040) border, containing three stacked bold ~15 pt lines: 'Sin(ω t)' in blue (#0000CC); 'Cos(ω t)' in blue (#0000CC); 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green (#009900).
11. Draw the slide-number badge at top-right (approx x 89-94%, y 10-17%): small yellow (#FFFF00) filled ellipse with a dark navy (#000080) outline, containing the black bold number '28' (~16 pt).
12. Optional, video-frame artifact only: add a solid black (#000000) rectangle strip across the full slide width at y 95-100% (~5% of slide height); skip this step when rebuilding the slide without the video frame.
Note: do NOT recreate the white mouse-pointer cursor visible near 'Word 1' (approx x 76%, y 38%); it is a screen-recording artifact, not slide content.
